text:
auditor_jenn: Hi team — auditor here. We saw an RBAC change on 2026-02-15 tied to a high-severity vuln triage. We need: KMS envelope proof that no key material was exported, the RBAC change rollback notes, and evidence that the vuln was remediated. Can you drop artifacts/paths and a short timeline? :eyes:

sara-security: @auditor_jenn thanks — we have a few artifacts ready. Quick clarifying Q: do you want the raw KMS API call traces or the decrypted envelope proof (HMAC + signer)?

auditor_jenn: Raw API traces preferred, plus the envelope HMAC if available. Also a short text timeline we can include in the control mapping doc.

alex-sre: Copy. I'll pull KMS CloudTrail events and the SIEM correlation. Expect an S3 bundle with signed manifests.

maria-eng: I created the rollback note and annotated the changelist. TL;DR: the RBAC change (role binding ID rb-942) was reverted within 12m after a failing canary flagged elevated scope. Patch for vuln CVE-2026-0142 deployed in the same window; mitigation steps are in the ticket.

alex-sre: Uploaded artifacts to a presigned bucket: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1808887776/
- cloudtrail_kms_events.json.gz
- siem_correlation_rbac_alerts.log.gz
- rb-942-rollback-notes.md
- vuln-0142-triage-and-mitigation.md
- manifest-signed.txt (SHA256 + sig)

sara-security: Also added an exported envelope proof (base64) with HMAC and verifier note: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1808887776/kms-envelope-proof.txt
Content snippet (from cloudtrail):
```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-02-15T14:03:12Z",
  "eventName": "Decrypt",
  "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-rbac-service" },
  "requestParameters": { "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01" }
}
```

sara-security: Important note: all Decrypt events show `recipientInfo` absent — nothing matches an external export pattern. HMAC in kms-envelope-proof.txt shows verification OK.

compliance-bot: Automated check: manifest-signed.txt signature verified by compliance key id ck-17. Hash matches uploaded artifacts. :white_check_mark:

auditor_jenn: This is great. Two quick asks: 1) Can you paste the rb-942 rollback note (short) inline here for context? 2) For the vulnerability mitigation, include the CVE patch PR link and the deployment IDs.

maria-eng: rb-942 rollback note (excerpt):
"Reverted role binding rb-942 due to unexpected permission expansion observed in canary. Revert applied 2026-02-15T14:15Z by maria-eng via ops-runbook v2.3. No external principals observed. Post-revert canary passed at 14:20Z. Related ticket: INF-3421."

alex-sre: CVE patch PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/patches/pull/1287
Deploy IDs: deploy-usw2-20260215-42, canary-run-20260215-17

auditor_jenn: Perfect. Last ask — can you confirm whether KMS CMK key policy changed in that window? If so include diff.

sara-security: No CMK policy change recorded in CloudTrail for key abcd-ef01 between 14:00-15:00Z. We do have a policy-diff audit entry at 2026-02-10 for a separate maintenance window; not related.

auditor_jenn: Thanks everyone. I'll attach these artifacts to the SOC2 evidence packet and map them to control CC6.2. If we need screenshots or signed attestations, I'll follow up. :thumbsup:
